name: Ga deo Le
summary: Gà tre from Đèo Le in Quế Sơn is a mountain chicken the 16 Apr 2024 city page calls a Da Nang specialty. The birds run free. The plate it describes is the chicken boiled with crushed purple shallot.
origin: Đèo Le, Quế Sơn, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, which tells a visitor in Da Nang to seek dishes made from this chicken.
howToEat: The page says the chicken is boiled with crushed purple shallot and eaten with rau răm and sliced lime leaf.
It is served whole, arranged with the wings spread in the shape the page calls cánh tiên.
where: Quế Sơn, on the 16 Apr 2024 page. A restaurant door and a ride time are not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ga deo Le — chicken from Que Son
seoDescription: Gà đèo Le is free-range chicken from Quế Sơn, boiled with purple shallot, rau răm, and lime leaf. The 16 Apr 2024 page names no restaurant. Check on arrival.
